dedupe_keys.name: helsinki region land cover dataset hsy

description: The Helsinki region land cover dataset of HSY classifies the land area into impermeable surfaces such as streets and buildings, vegetation of different heights, open rock and bare ground. It is produced from orthoimages, lidar point clouds and municipal GIS data every two years since 2014, in co-operation between HSY and the municipalities; the 2022 and 2024 editions used AI classification, and the 2024 edition covers Helsinki, Espoo, Vantaa, Kauniainen, Kirkkonummi, Kerava, Järvenpää, Tuusula and Nurmijärvi. The data is available online in the HSY web map service, through open geographic interfaces and as download packages in vector layers by land cover group and raster 2.5-kilometre grid cells (ETRS-GK25), with a method report, and there is a version where trees overhang streets and buildings to show the actual canopy. HSY also publishes locations of trees in Helsinki 2013, derived by DLR in the Decumanus project from laser scanning and an NDVI canopy layer. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 and use is free. Caveats: the page warns that editions differ because of shadows in orthoimages and method changes, so the series is not fully consistent. Coverage is the Helsinki region. It supports urban heat, stormwater and green infrastructure analysis around roads and buildings; related records are the Copenhagen street trees and the Zurich tree cadastre.
